description:
Create a relationship between two nodes in a deployed graph project.

The rel_type must match a relationship key from the project schema.
Use get_graph_data_schema to see available relationship types.

Example:
  rel_type: "authored"
  from_id: "alan-turing-001"
  to_id: "on-computable-numbers-001"
  data: {"year": 1936}

The from_id and to_id must be entity_ids of existing nodes. An end also accepts a node of an entity nested
under the one the relationship names: name its entity key in from_type / to_type (the relationship's
from_types / to_types in get_graph_data_schema), e.g. to_type "topic_technicaltopic" for a COVERS to Topic.

from_type.description: Entity key of the source node, when it is an entity nested under the relationship's own (optional)

to_type.description: Entity key of the target node, when it is an entity nested under the relationship's own (optional)

name: create_graph_relationship
title: Create Graph Relationship
